headline: Gold and silver fall again today; 24K gold near ₹12,458 per gram
summary: Gold 24K is down ₹322 per gram (-2.52%) from yesterday's ₹12,780, and silver is down ₹10,000 per kg (-5.71%) to ₹1,65,000. Over the last 7 days gold 24K is down 6.51% and silver 10.81%, and within the 31 days covered by the data, gold has fallen from ₹14,275 to ₹12,458 and silver from ₹2,20,000 to ₹1,65,000. Likely drivers include the weaker international gold and silver prices in dollar terms, with the rupee's level against the US dollar also a factor; these are possibilities, not confirmed causes.
outlook: Prices are at the lowest levels in the data set, so if you are buying jewellery or coins, compare the day's rate with making charges and GST before deciding, and avoid rushing in on a single day's move.
